form.label: Mission Control Simulator
form.description: Demo analyst queue using indexed demo:es:incident rows when ES detections cannot create native Mission Control findings.

div.p: Analyst queue view backed by index=demo_security sourcetype=demo:es:incident.

html.div: This is a demo substitute when ES event-based detections cannot write findings to native Mission Control.

search.query: index=demo_security sourcetype=demo:es:incident | search soc_queue="$soc_queue$" OR "$soc_queue$"="*" | stats count AS value
index=demo_security sourcetype=demo:es:incident | search soc_queue="$soc_queue$" OR "$soc_queue$"="*" | search severity IN ("critical","high") | stats count AS value
index=demo_security sourcetype=demo:es:incident | search soc_queue="$soc_queue$" OR "$soc_queue$"="*" | stats dc(snow_incident_number) AS value

index=demo_security sourcetype=demo:es:incident | search soc_queue="$soc_queue$" OR "$soc_queue$"="*" | eval Title=name, ID=notable_id, Entity=risk_object, Urgency=urgency, Status=status_name, Owner=assignee | table _time Title ID Entity Urgency Status Owner soc_queue snow_incident_number cmdb_ci business_service severity correlation_search mitre_tactic mitre_technique | sort - _time
index=demo_security sourcetype=demo:es:incident | search soc_queue="$soc_queue$" OR "$soc_queue$"="*" | stats count AS Items by status_name | sort - Items
index=demo_security sourcetype=demo:es:incident | search soc_queue="$soc_queue$" OR "$soc_queue$"="*" | stats count AS Items by urgency | sort - Items
